titleZh: 单元复习:我的家人和新朋友
goalZh: 读懂并会讲一段介绍家人和朋友的短文,复习本单元的家人、外貌和性格词
canDoZh: 能用一小段话介绍自己的家人和新朋友:他们是谁、长什么样、是什么样的人

newItems.noteZh: best 结尾的 t 碰上 friend 的 f,常常轻到听不见:“bes-friend”。
I miss my family. 我想家了;miss 还有“错过”的意思:miss the bus。
美国人说 love 很随意:I love this song! = 我超喜欢这首歌;词尾 v 下唇要轻轻振动。
go home 回家、at home 在家(go home 不加 to);想家:I miss home。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: My name is Lei, and I'm from Chengdu, China.

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: There are four people in my family.

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: My dad is an engineer, and my mom is a teacher.
lines.zh: 我爸爸是工程师,我妈妈是老师。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: My grandma lives with us. She has glasses, and she's really funny.
lines.zh: 我奶奶和我们住在一起。她戴眼镜,特别逗。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I'm an only child, but my cousin is my best friend.
lines.zh: 我是独生子,不过我表姐是我最好的朋友。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Now I'm a freshman in Seattle.
lines.zh: 现在我在西雅图读大一。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: My roommate, Ethan, is from California.
lines.zh: 我的室友伊森来自加州。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: He's tall, and he's very friendly.

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Amy is really nice, and she's smart.

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Sofia has long black hair, and she has a big family.
lines.zh: 索菲亚留着黑色长发,她家是个大家庭。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I miss my family and my home.
lines.zh: 我想念我的家人,也想家。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: But I love Seattle, and I have great friends here.
lines.zh: 但我爱西雅图,在这里我也有很好的朋友。

questions.prompt: 磊的奶奶是什么样的人?
questions.explainZh: My grandma lives with us. She has glasses, and she's really funny.(她戴眼镜,特别逗。)
I'm an only child, but my cousin is my best friend.(我是独生子,不过我表姐是我最好的朋友。)
Sofia has long black hair.(索菲亚留着黑色长发。)戴眼镜的是磊的奶奶。

questions.prompt: 短文最后,磊的心情是怎样的?
options: 他想家,但在西雅图也有好朋友
questions.explainZh: I miss my family and my home. But I love Seattle, and I have great friends here.

grammar.titleZh: 用 and 和 but 把句子连起来
grammar.bodyZh: 两句话意思顺着说,用 and(而且;和);意思有转折,用 but(但是;不过)。写短文时用它们把短句连起来,读起来更顺,也更像一篇文章:I'm an only child, but my cousin is my best friend.。连接两个完整的句子时,and、but 前面一般加逗号。朗读时在逗号、句号处稍微停顿,陈述句句末语调下降 ↘。

examples.text: My dad is an engineer, and my mom is a teacher.
examples.zh: 我爸爸是工程师,我妈妈是老师。

examples.text: I miss my family, but I love Seattle.
He's tall, and he's very friendly.

grammar.titleZh: 单元小结:介绍家人和朋友的四个句型
grammar.bodyZh: ① 谁的:my / your / his / her / our / their + 名词(my mom、her family)。② 有:I have…,he / she has…(She has a big family.)。③ 几口人:There are four people in my family.。④ 什么样:be + 形容词说性格和高矮(He's tall. She's really nice.),have / has 说头发、眼镜(She has long black hair.)。主语是 he、she 或一个人时,动词要加 -s:has、lives、works,写的时候特别容易漏。

examples.zh: 我奶奶和我们住在一起。

examples.text: There are four people in my family.
